title: Liberty's All-Star Breanna Stewart Believes Storm's All-Star Ezi Magbegor Learned Mental Toughness From Herself & Sue Bird
htmlContent:
Breanna Stewart is a highly accomplished basketball player who has had a significant impact on the sport. Her skills and knowledge have not only made her a dominant force on the court but have also allowed her to mentor and influence younger players, including Ezi Magbegor.

Ezi Magbegor, a talented young basketball player, had the privilege of playing alongside Stewart and Sue Bird last year. This experience provided her with a unique opportunity to learn from two of the best in the game. Stewart's presence and leadership undoubtedly played a crucial role in shaping Magbegor's growth and development as a player.

"I think Ezi learned a lot, and I think the biggest is her mindset and doing what it takes to have a strong mental toughness," said Stewart.

"Understand that there are a lot of plays that happen throughout the game; some are bad, but a lot more will be good. Her ability to play through that and understand those spots."

One area where Magbegor would have undoubtedly learned from Stewart is her work ethic and dedication to the game. Stewart is known for her relentless commitment to improving her skills and maintaining a high level of fitness. This level of dedication would have undoubtedly rubbed off on Magbegor, inspiring her to push herself harder and strive for greatness.

Stewart's versatility on the court is another aspect that Magbegor would have admired and learned from. Stewart has the ability to excel in multiple positions, making her a valuable asset to any team. Magbegor, being a versatile player herself, would have absorbed valuable insights from Stewart on how to adapt to different roles and contribute effectively in various situations.

Additionally, Sue Bird's presence alongside Stewart would have provided Magbegor with an invaluable opportunity to learn from one of the greatest point guards in the history of women's basketball. Bird's court vision, leadership, and ability to control the flow of the game are qualities that Magbegor would have observed and tried to incorporate into her own game.

Overall, Breanna Stewart's influence on Ezi Magbegor cannot be understated. Through their time together, Magbegor would have gained a deeper understanding of what it takes to succeed at the highest level and the importance of a strong work ethic, versatility, and leadership. As Magbegor continues her basketball journey, she will undoubtedly carry these lessons with her and strive to reach new heights, thanks to the guidance and mentorship of players like Stewart and Bird.
